remaining.what: Outside a return, a weekly review (or any handler that applies its rule) records the next week's start as WEEK_EVIDENCE. It carries, unchanged, every value its evidence did not move from the week's own start, even when that start was an unverified projection. historicalWeekStart checks that base only while return steps are under way. So in a program's first weeks, after a SHORT return or after a completed return, a load or count only the plan assumed becomes evidence-anchored history and reaches a resumed dose or a return ceiling

notReadyRecord.newManifestationOfProjectedVsHistorical: Yes (the judge). A projected value acquires historical authority because a later decision stored it, here the canonical weekly review that held it. It is not QE-R7AF-01's path: no earlier return and no unrelated handler
notReadyRecord.requiresHistoryStateModelRevision: Yes (the judge). At minimum, evidence authority must be recursive on every week, not only inside a return: a reviewed start is history only when the start it was computed from is history, or the week was executed in full. An exact answer needs per-value provenance (which values the review moved from evidence and which it carried), which the contract's B8 calls a new state model
notReadyRecord.whyTheCurrentSolutionWasInsufficient: Authority is recorded per start and per sport, and WEEK_EVIDENCE certifies the review's transition, not the base it was applied to. The author bounded the base check to returns, where week-level absorption is precise. Applied on every week, week-level absorption keeps an athlete who misses a session every week out of history for good after one unverified week (the reason for the bound, contract B8), so the exact repair is per value
notReadyRecord.authorReading: Separate from the judge: the two options trade conservatism against precision. (a) Recursive authority on every week is a small change but discards reviewed progress after one unverified week until a week is executed in full; the SSCTR's NF-R7AB-1 already shows that cost inside a return. (b) Per-value provenance (per exercise and per run dimension: moved by evidence, or carried from a base with its own authority) is exact but adds a per-value record to every start and to the reading of history: a state-model decision
notReadyRecord.smallestArchitecturalDecision: Whether evidence authority is recursive on every week (option a), or recorded per value (option b). Related, not blocking: QE-R7AB-03 (§11 scope for training enclosed before the first report), SSCTR R40 (per-sport walk-back), QE-R7AB-02, QE-R7AF-03/04, R38, R39
